latestVersion.changelog:
- Initial release of "Video Editing with AI Online" skill.
- Enables fast, AI-powered editing of raw video footage (MP4, MOV, AVI, WebM, up to 500MB) with cloud-based processing.
- Supports file upload, text-based editing instructions, automatic captioning, transitions, BGM, and export to 1080p MP4.
- Session-based workflow; automatic handling of authentication and credits.
- Includes user-friendly error handling and status updates.
- Suitable for content creators and marketers to edit and export professional videos without desktop software.
